# WP Config Doctor

> Audit and harden your wp-config.php in the browser: security and performance checks plus a fresh salt generator. Credentials never leave the device.

## Tool

- [WP Config Doctor](https://jaydenyoonzk.github.io/wp-config-doctor/): the tool itself, a static page that runs entirely in the browser with no accounts and no data collection

## Documentation

- [README](https://github.com/JaydenYoonZK/wp-config-doctor#readme): what the tool does, how it works, and its engineering notes
- [Changelog](https://github.com/JaydenYoonZK/wp-config-doctor/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): dated release history

## Source

- [Repository](https://github.com/JaydenYoonZK/wp-config-doctor): MIT licensed source code
